principle: Observed mechanics first; runtime ontology later.

primitives.label: Resource
primitives.description: Named quantity that can be gained, spent, marked, cleared, or capped.

primitives.label: Counter / Track / Countdown
primitives.description: Ordered numeric or stepped progress state.

primitives.label: State / Condition
primitives.description: Named state that changes available rules or effects.

primitives.label: Tag
primitives.description: Semantic label used by rules for filtering, eligibility, or interaction.

primitives.label: Slot / Capacity
primitives.description: Finite capacity expressed as slots or equivalent bounded storage.

primitives.label: Spend / Gain / Mark / Clear
primitives.description: Atomic mutation of a resource or track.

primitives.label: Die / Dice Pool
primitives.description: Die-valued quantity or composable pool used by a procedure.

primitives.label: Result Table
primitives.description: Roll/input mapped to discrete outcomes.

primitives.label: Tier Progression
primitives.description: Rules or values that scale by character/campaign tier.

primitives.label: Linked Entity
primitives.description: Rule object that references another entity rather than duplicating it.

primitives.label: Recipe / Craft
primitives.description: Inputs transformed into an item, upgrade, or effect.

primitives.label: Upgrade Slot
primitives.description: Bounded socket/slot that grants selected improvements.

primitives.label: Segmented Entity
primitives.description: Entity composed of independently addressable parts/segments.

primitives.label: Graph / Hex Travel
primitives.description: Movement procedure over nodes, routes, hexes, or locations.

primitives.label: Rest Rule
primitives.description: Constraint or modifier on short/long rests and recovery.

primitives.label: Phase / Procedure
primitives.description: Ordered multi-step gameplay procedure or named phase.

primitives.label: Form / State Transition
primitives.description: Rule-driven transition between forms, modes, or states.

primitives.label: Relation / Faction
primitives.description: Persistent relationship value between entities/groups.

primitives.label: Threshold
primitives.description: Numeric boundary that changes result/state once crossed.

primitives.label: Triggered Rule
primitives.description: Rule that activates on an event or condition.

primitives.label: Campaign Rule Modifier
primitives.description: Campaign-level override or modifier to otherwise global rules.

primitives.label: Play Aid
primitives.description: Sheet/reference aid used by a mechanic or campaign procedure.

primitives.label: Map / Handout
primitives.description: Referenced visual asset attached to a campaign procedure.

coverage_notes.homebrew_kit: The Homebrew Kit remains design-guidance evidence and is not automatically treated as playable mechanics in this census.
coverage_notes.monster_hunter: No Monster Hunter/Chasse primitive evidence is fabricated from memory. If no normalized local file exists, P1.5 will add it as an explicit coverage corpus.
